expenditures.detail: exact (17,409.64 = 17,409.64). 16 rows on p8 sum to the attachment's own printed TOTALS $ 17,409.64, which equals the Summary Page Column A

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The itemization is a filer SPREADSHEET, not the form's grid, so no page prints 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' - that gate cannot fire on p4/p5/p6/p8 (the blank form pages 3 and 7 leave their SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells empty). The gate applied instead is each attachment's own printed grand total: contributions p4+p5+p6 rows sum 24,319.10 = printed TOTAL 24,319.10 (PASS); expenditures p8 rows sum 17,409.64 = printed TOTALS 17,409.64 (PASS).
itemized.escalation_note: All four attachment pages are LANDSCAPE; re-rendered at 300dpi and rotated 90 deg CLOCKWISE with PIL (the opposite sign from the Crockett filing in this same chunk - the sign is per file), then split into left/right halves to keep effective resolution near 235 dpi through the Read tool's downsampling.
itemized.notes: PAGE ORDER: p3 = blank 'Itemized Contributions Received' form with 'See Attached'; p4-p6 = the contributions spreadsheet (landscape, 75 rows); p7 = blank 'Itemized Expenditures Made' form with 'See Attached'; p8 = the expenditures spreadsheet (landscape, 16 rows). REDACTION: the county redaction bar covers the CITY column on every attachment page (and, on p4, the STATE column too), so donor_city is blank throughout with 'redacted' in the note. Fragments of a few city names peek past the right edge of the bar on p5 ('...n', '...ed', '...lle', '...dan') - deliberately NOT reconstructed. On p5/p6 the STATE column is legible and is recorded (36 UT, 1 OH). Dates are full m/d/yyyy on both attachments and parse cleanly. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: p4 33 dates / 33 names / 33 amounts; p5 37/37/37; p6 5/5/5; p8 16 dates / 16 payees / 16 purposes / 16 amounts - PASS on every page, with the occupation and employer cells re-checked against their vertical positions row by row (e.g. Sperry/Physician/U of U Hospital, Skordas/Attorney/Skordas,Caston, Callister/Attorney/Callister Nebeker all line up). IN-KIND: 4 contribution rows and 4 expenditure rows carry an explicit 'In Kind' marker; the largest (Market Street Cottonwood, 5,569.10) appears on BOTH sides as the same fundraiser, and the two Internet Properties 600.00 rent items likewise. The expenditure attachment spells the same vendor 'Market Street Cottownwood' (double w) while the contribution attachment spells it 'Market Street Cottonwood' - both kept verbatim. GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on all attachment rows (landscape scans; a back-converted portrait-frame band could not be pinned tighter than the row pitch).
